import EntryLog.Spec
import EntryLog.Lemmas

namespace EntryLog

instance instDecidableValidEntry (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidEntry s e) := by
  unfold ValidEntry
  infer_instance

def step (s : State) (e : Entry) : Outcome × State :=
  match receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some n => (.ok n, s)
  | none =>
    if ValidEntry s e then
      let s' : State :=
        { s with
          log := s.log ++ [e],
          balance := fun a => s.balance a + if a = e.account then e.amount else 0 }
      (.ok s.log.length, s')
    else
      (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s e hnotin hvalid
  unfold ValidSucceeds
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hvalid]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s e hnotin hinvalid
  unfold InvalidNoop
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hinvalid]

theorem req_duplicate : DuplicateReturnsOriginal step := by
  intro s e n hrec
  unfold DuplicateReturnsOriginal
  simp [step, hrec]

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  intro s e hnotin hvalid
  unfold Effects
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hvalid]
  constructor
  · rfl
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro a; rfl

theorem req_append_only : AppendOnly step := by
  intro s e
  unfold AppendOnly
  cases h : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    exact ⟨[], by simp [step, h]⟩
  | none =>
    split
    · rename_i hvalid
      exact ⟨[e], by simp [step, h, hvalid]⟩
    · exact ⟨[], by simp [step, h]⟩

theorem req_unique_ids : UniqueIds step := by
  intro s e hnodup
  unfold UniqueIds
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec]
    exact hnodup
  | none =>
    split
    · rename_i hvalid
      have hnotin : e.id ∉ ids s.log := by
        by_contra hmem
        have ⟨n, hn⟩ := receiptOf_isSome hmem
        rw [hn] at hrec
        cases hrec
      have hids : ids (s.log ++ [e]) = ids s.log ++ [e.id] := by
        simp [ids_append]
      simp [step, hrec, hvalid, hids]
      apply List.Nodup.append
      · exact hnodup
      · simp
      · intro x hx
        simp [List.mem_append] at hx
        rcases hx with h | h
        · exact hnotin h
        · cases h with
          | inl h => subst h; exact hnotin (by simp)
          | inr h => cases h
    · simp [step, hrec]

theorem req_nonnegative : NonNegative step := by
  intro s e hnn a ha
  unfold NonNegative at hnn
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec] at ha ⊢
    exact hnn a ha
  | none =>
    split
    · rename_i hvalid
      simp [step, hrec, hvalid] at ha ⊢
      have hacc : a ∈ s.accounts := by
        -- accounts are unchanged
        simpa using ha
      by_cases hae : a = e.account
      · subst hae
        have hmem : e.account ∈ s.accounts := by
          unfold ValidEntry at hvalid
          exact hvalid.1
        have hge : 0 ≤ s.balance e.account + e.amount := by
          unfold ValidEntry at hvalid
          exact hvalid.2.2
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        exact hge
      · rw [if_neg hae]
        exact hnn a hacc
    · simp [step, hrec] at ha ⊢
      exact hnn a ha

theorem req_consistent : StaysConsistent step := by
  intro s e hcons
  unfold StaysConsistent Consistent
  intro a
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec]
    exact hcons a
  | none =>
    split
    · rename_i hvalid
      simp [step, hrec, hvalid]
      have hlog : logSum (s.log ++ [e]) a = logSum s.log a + (if e.account = a then e.amount else 0) := by
        unfold logSum
        rw [sumOver_append]
        simp
      rw [hlog, hcons a]
      simp [if_comm]
    · simp [step, hrec]
      exact hcons a

end EntryLog

import EntryLog.Spec
import EntryLog.Lemmas

namespace EntryLog

instance instDecidableValidEntry (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidEntry s e) := by
  unfold ValidEntry
  infer_instance

def step (s : State) (e : Entry) : Outcome × State :=
  match receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some n => (.ok n, s)
  | none =>
    if h : ValidEntry s e then
      let s' : State :=
        { s with
          log := s.log ++ [e],
          balance := fun a => s.balance a + if a = e.account then e.amount else 0 }
      (.ok s.log.length, s')
    else
      (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s e hnotin hvalid
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hvalid]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s e hnotin hinvalid
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hinvalid]

theorem req_duplicate : DuplicateReturnsOriginal step := by
  intro s e n hrec
  simp [step, hrec]

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  intro s e hnotin hvalid
  simp [step]
  have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := receiptOf_eq_none hnotin
  simp [hnone, hvalid]
  constructor
  · rfl
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro a; rfl

theorem req_append_only : AppendOnly step := by
  intro s e
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    exact ⟨[], by simp [step, hrec]⟩
  | none =>
    by_cases hvalid : ValidEntry s e
    · exact ⟨[e], by simp [step, hrec, hvalid]⟩
    · exact ⟨[], by simp [step, hrec, hvalid]⟩

theorem req_unique_ids : UniqueIds step := by
  intro s e hnodup
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec]
    exact hnodup
  | none =>
    by_cases hvalid : ValidEntry s e
    · have hnotin : e.id ∉ ids s.log := by
        by_contra hmem
        have ⟨n, hn⟩ := receiptOf_isSome hmem
        rw [hn] at hrec
        cases hrec
      have hids : ids (s.log ++ [e]) = ids s.log ++ [e.id] := by
        simp [ids_append]
      simp [step, hrec, hvalid, hids]
      apply List.Nodup.append
      · exact hnodup
      · simp
      · intro x hx
        simp [List.mem_append] at hx
        rcases hx with h | h
        · exact hnotin h
        · cases h
    · simp [step, hrec, hvalid]
      exact hnodup

theorem req_nonnegative : NonNegative step := by
  intro s e hnn a ha
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec] at ha ⊢
    exact hnn a ha
  | none =>
    by_cases hvalid : ValidEntry s e
    · simp [step, hrec, hvalid] at ha ⊢
      have hacc : a ∈ s.accounts := by
        simpa using ha
      unfold ValidEntry at hvalid
      by_cases hae : a = e.account
      · subst hae
        have hmem : e.account ∈ s.accounts := hvalid.1
        have hge : 0 ≤ s.balance e.account + e.amount := hvalid.2.2
        simp
        exact hge
      · simp [hae]
        exact hnn a hacc
    · simp [step, hrec, hvalid] at ha ⊢
      exact hnn a ha

theorem req_consistent : StaysConsistent step := by
  intro s e hcons a
  cases hrec : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some _ =>
    simp [step, hrec]
    exact hcons a
  | none =>
    by_cases hvalid : ValidEntry s e
    · simp [step, hrec, hvalid]
      have hlog : logSum (s.log ++ [e]) a = logSum s.log a + (if e.account = a then e.amount else 0) := by
        unfold logSum
        rw [sumOver_append]
        simp
      rw [hlog, hcons a]
      by_cases hae : a = e.account
      · simp [hae]
      · simp [hae]
        ring
    · simp [step, hrec, hvalid]
      exact hcons a

end EntryLog
